slides.title:
Faster releases,
*fewer surprises*
slides.subtitle: What shipped, what we learned, and what we commit to next quarter.

slides.title: Three things that moved the numbers
slides.subtitle: Out of eleven launches, these had the largest measurable effect.
items: Self-serve onboarding cut *time to first value* from 9 days to 3.
The new export API removed the top support request of the quarter.
Weekly release trains replaced ad-hoc deploys across all teams.
slides.takeaway: Smaller, more frequent releases gave us *earlier feedback* at lower risk.

slides.title: Support load dropped by a third
slides.subtitle: Tickets per 1,000 active accounts, compared with last quarter.
slides.takeaway: Fewer tickets free roughly *two engineer-weeks* per month.
